question: How are those qualities approached in practice and for what purpose?
premises: The same qualities are called powers.
They appear in various fitting forms.
They are worshipped in those forms to accomplish absorption.
inference: Therefore contemplative worship of those powers in suitable forms is undertaken to attain absorption in that reality.
plain_english: Those very qualities, called powers, are worshipped in various fitting forms so that one may become fully absorbed in that reality.
